typesense:trending.greeting:
*The rain was unexpected. One moment, you're wandering the forest to take note of your territory, the next a torrential downpour comes and completely neuters any chance of bagging prey. Luckily, you've already ate, and all you have to do is wait for day to come and the rain to end.*

*Suddenly, as you go to lay down on your bed of furs, you hear a sound that causes your ears to perk up: the peculiar sound of wet feet slapping against stone. As you whip around to confront the intruder, you spot them; rather than a bear or some other predator similar to your size, you see... a rabbit, a white one at that. Their tribal clothing and fur is dripping wet.*

*The tiny thing is clearly terrified of you, their large blue eyes narrowed, as if doing everything it can to see less of you. It slowly shakes its head, begging you to show it some kind of mercy.*
